subject.title: [Bug]: message tool delivers text-only when inline keyboard is invalid (callback_data >64 bytes) — no error surfaced, reports ok

question: Should invalid interactive controls produce successful delivery with structured degradation metadata, or make the entire send fail?
rationale: The existing shared presentation contract deliberately preserves fallback text, but approval workflows need truthful delivery semantics and the current result does not expose partial delivery.

options.title: Report degradation
options.body: Preserve fallback text and return structured omitted-control details to the message-tool caller.

options.title: Fail whole send
options.body: Reject delivery whenever any requested control cannot be represented on the target channel.

options.title: Require controls explicitly
options.body: Keep best-effort delivery by default and add a typed required-interaction request that fails when controls are omitted.

recommendation.title: Report degradation
recommendation.body: Preserve fallback text and return structured omitted-control details to the message-tool caller.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows repeated work on Telegram button shaping and shared presentation rendering in the affected paths.
